subject.title: fix: active-memory recall fails with billing rejections on subscription-only Claude CLI setups

question: Should subscription-auth dispatch eligibility be moved into Anthropic-owned CliBackendConfig capability metadata before this PR merges, or is the core claude-cli exception an intentional supported contract?
rationale: Both implementations can fix the observed bug, but repository policy assigns provider-specific auth and routing behavior to provider-owned seams; only maintainers can approve an exception or choose the permanent API boundary.

options.title: Use provider capability metadata
options.body: Move the claude-cli eligibility signal into the Anthropic CLI backend configuration and let the embedded runner consume it through a generic capability check.

options.title: Approve the core exception
options.body: Merge the hardcoded core provider gate as an intentional contract and explicitly own its compatibility and future-provider extension cost.

recommendation.title: Use provider capability metadata
recommendation.body: Move the claude-cli eligibility signal into the Anthropic CLI backend configuration and let the embedded runner consume it through a generic capability check.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans the embedded agent runner, CLI backend architecture, and provider/plugin ownership boundary reflected in prior agent-harness work.
